visuals.label: Figure 2
visuals.caption: (Colour online) Sketch of the surface evolution convected by the virtual or physical velocity in a non-ideal ﬂow. At time t0, the black solid surface denotes the initial vortex tube M(t0) with vortex lines (black lines with arrows), the surface normal n = ∇φv/|∇φv| and the vorticity ﬂux Φ(t0). At time t, the blue surface Mv(t0) denotes the vortex surface convected by v; the red surface Mu(t0) denotes the material surface convected by u. The dotted blue and solid red lines with arrows denote trajectories of Xv(x0, t0; t) and Xu(x0, t0; t) from the same initial position x0 but convected by v and u, respectively.
